title: [AINews] Inkling 2 Small: 17A-594B trained in 68 hours on 12T tokens, beating Muse Spark
author: swyx .ai
description: November 5, 2026 — Inside Inkling 2 Small’s training run and METR’s study of AI research at Anthropic.
summary: Build AI systems with context graphs and agentic memory. Join Andrew Ng and AI engineers at NODES 2026 for 100+ live technical sessions .
takeaways: Launch: Announced at 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, "a big jump over its predecessor." Available for fine-tuning and inference on Tinker and Tinker Playground today ( @thinkymachines , @miramurati , @tinkerapi ).

Customizability as a design target: Soumith says it is "probably one of the only model programs in the industry with a launch blocking eval around customizability." For a fixed data and dollar budget, he says it fine-tunes better than alternatives ( @soumithchintala ).
Benchmark Inkling 2 Small Sonnet 5.5 (medium) FrontierCode 2.0 25% 11% Terminal-Bench 4.0 13% 30% Creative agentic: On AA-3D it scores above Claude Haiku 5.5 and Grok 4.7.
